targets.note: Elena Rivera's record page: title, the completeness ring (10 of 11, Ask for these), the fields in the type's sections (Contact, Deal, Linked, Notes; Private folded), relation cards, a note with [[ links, and the Activity tab at the right. The prototype side is its record page in the same skin; it lays the sheet out in one column with its own sample fields.
The relationship map two hops out: the record in the middle, its projects around it. The prototype side is its relationship map for the same kind of record.
The phone field open for editing in place, no Save button. The prototype edits a field the same way, in the sheet.
The right pane on Memory: what agents remember about this record, with the way back to the source. The prototype side is its record page with the memory section open.
The right pane on History: the shared History tab with the record's versions, who and why.
The same page over the Harbor Studio sample Space.

The navigate probe, in-app: performance marks nav-start when a row is opened and nav-end when the record page content first paints; browser.mjs reads the measure on the perf runner (budget 50 ms, median of 5 after a warm-up).
